depot: artificial centroid of serialized source coordinates rounded to three decimals
distance_rule: current parser rebuilds Euclidean serialized UTM coordinate distance / 1.5 m/s

inventory_regimes.balanced: target total exactly; moderate local imbalance
inventory_regimes.shortage: target total minus max(V, round(0.12*target total)); high local imbalance
inventory_regimes.surplus: target total plus max(V, round(0.12*target total)), capped by total capacity; high local imbalance

seed_policy: positive 31-bit display seeds and all ordering/scalars derived from SHA-256 material

station_selection.anchor_set: SHA-256-ranked initial anchor followed by deterministic farthest-first anchors
station_selection.compact: V nearest eligible stations to anchor
station_selection.regional: farthest-first V-station coverage within the 2V nearest eligible stations

target_rule: per-station fill fraction 0.44+0.12*hash_unit, rounded half-up and bounded [1,capacity]
